notes:
POC summary: customer requested 3-week Dedicated POC to validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs before committing to a reserved GPU contract. Primary ask: prove sustainable 450 req/s (avg payload ~600 tokens) with p95 latency <= 150ms for chat/rerank flows. Also need throughput curve for 1-16 GPUs to inform reserved planning. They emphasized graceful degradation/fallback to smaller model variant when capacity constrained. 

Representative sample prompts used in load tests:
- chat: "Customer: I've noticed an unexplained charge on my account, walk me through how to dispute it and what evidence is needed?" (avg 420 tokens)
- rerank: top-50 candidate ranking for fraud signals; queries include transaction metadata and textual notes (avg 280 tokens)
- embedding/semantic search: 512-token product descriptions for similarity retrieval across 12M vectors

Test plan (high level):
- Week 0: infra prep + security checklist (VPC peering + KMS proof)
- Week 1: baseline single-GPU latency profile (p50/p95/p99) on 8k seq/512 seq
- Week 2: linear scale test across 1/2/4/8/16 GPUs; capture tail latency and tokens/sec
- Week 3: 72-hour soak at target throughput (450 req/s sustained), validate memory growth and KV cache performance
- Deliverables: perf report, capacity recommendation (GPUs and model variants), SLA proposal (uptime, p95, credits)

Key customer comments: "Latency is business-critical — even small tail shifts reduce fraud catch rates." Security lead: requires customer-managed key (KMS) and data residency in US-East. Procurement: prefers 12-month reserved contract but wants escape clause tied to SLA attainment. SE notes: need to benchmark prefix-caching benefits for repeated historical queries.
